name: Senoia
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Senoia?
answer_short: Yes, with a city registration. In Senoia, motorized carts may use streets posted 35 mph or less, but not State Route 16 or State Route 85 except at a crossing. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

lsv.notes: Not the parts of SR 16 and SR 85 posted over 35

rules.rule: Motorized carts on streets posted 35 mph or less; not on State Highway 16 or 85 except authorized crossings
Registered LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Senoia?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Not the parts of SR 16 and SR 85 posted over 35. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on State Route 16 in Senoia?
faq.a: No. You may cross it where the city has an authorized crossing, not drive along it.

faq.q: Do I need to register a golf cart in Senoia?
faq.a: Yes. Senoia requires a city registration decal before a cart uses public streets or paths.
